name: Okra
siboNotes: Okra is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides soluble fiber that may support gut healing.
preparationTips: Trim stems and tips before cooking to reduce sliminess
Cook at high heat or add acidic ingredients like lemon juice to minimize mucilage
Slice just before cooking to prevent excessive slime release
Works well grilled, roasted, or stir-fried for better texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and folate
